verdict.rationale: Bento has reusable email templates (create once, update everywhere), and its CLI includes a 'manage templates' capability, so templates can be handled programmatically to some degree. However, the documented authoring modes are plain text or a drag-and-drop editor, not HTML/MJML files kept in a repo. Missing for 10: HTML/MJML template authoring, documented template API endpoints, variable substitution in email templates, any version-control or templates-as-code workflow, and independent corroboration.
